verdict.rationale: Databricks documents that its SQL warehouse runs directly on the customer's data lake with Delta Lake, without moving the data. OpenSharing lets data be shared with users outside the organization regardless of whether they use Databricks. A community comment confirms data lands in Parquet/Delta, though it notes the performance optimizations stay proprietary. There is no documented end-to-end export or exit path for all assets (notebooks, dashboards, metadata), so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-export/offboarding documentation, coverage of non-table assets (notebooks, dashboards, models, governance metadata), independent hands-on confirmation of a clean exit.
